kjv: Who raised up the righteous [man] from the east
mine: Who stirred up one from the east whom victory meets at every step
note: Hebrew tsedeq yiqra'ehu leraglo is "victory/righteousness calls him to its foot", i.e. success attends him; the conqueror is Cyrus (cf. 44:28), not a "righteous man". The KJV makes tsedeq an attribute of the person.
